steps.title: Define Project Specifications
steps.description: Establish the application target configurations matching Android SDK 34, AGP 8.3.2, and Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Configure Application Manifest permissions
steps.description: Add Record Audio, Internet, and Query All Packages permissions inside the AndroidManifest.xml for full speech execution and app launch functionality.

steps.title: Create Build Gradle Configurations
steps.description: Define standard compiler flags, specify package namespace 'com.geminivoiceassistant.app', and target Java 1.8 compatibility options.

steps.title: Design Interactive Layout UI Customizations
steps.description: Create high-fidelity drawable shapes to style standard elements and background panels for visual polish.

steps.title: Define UI Component Tree Structure
steps.description: Implement activity_main.xml with chat flow text view displays, structured status layouts, interactive setting actions, and a primary speaking node.

steps.title: Implement Initialization Lifecycle and Permissions Check
steps.description: Handle real-time permission flow requesting permissions like RECORD_AUDIO inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Configure Speech-To-Text Recognition System
steps.description: Implement android.speech.SpeechRecognizer with custom listeners to listen, process speech inputs, and change activity state visually.

steps.title: Create Voice App Launch Controller
steps.description: Implement local intent parsers scanning device application databases via PackageManager to start user-requested software.

steps.title: Develop Network Request Layer for Gemini Models
steps.description: Build raw HttpURLConnection post handlers to exchange chat strings securely using stored API configuration preferences.

steps.title: Establish Dynamic Settings Dialog Interface
steps.description: Develop customizable dialog popups supporting model change and real-time validation of the developer key credentials.

steps.title: Hook TextToSpeech Feedback Engine
steps.description: Connect Android engine speak protocols returning vocal feedback streams on API response updates.

steps.title: Building Gemini Voice Assistant
steps.description: Compiling and packaging the Gemini Voice Assistant application into the final APK.
